title: Generalization Analogies (GENIES): A Testbed for Generalizing AI Oversight to Hard-To-Measure Domains

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using a specific probing distribution shift (alpaca_mmlu to gender_bias) to test whether reward models misgeneralize by preferring responses that exhibit gender bias.

Evaluated using probing distribution shifts (e.g., sycophancy_mimicry, sycophancy_are_you_sure) to test if models prefer responses that pander to user opinions or exhibit agreeable personas rather than accurately following instructions.

Evaluated using spurious cue distribution shifts (e.g., alpaca_short to alpaca_long) to determine if reward models rely on a 'length heuristic' (preferring longer or shorter responses) rather than evaluating task completion.
Evaluated by comparing the fine-tuned reward model's judgments against a zero-shot policy to test if models spuriously favor low-perplexity, internet-like text over actual instruction-following.
Evaluated using Cognitive Reflection Test (CRT) datasets to test whether reward models prefer responses that imitate human logical misconceptions and cognitive biases.
